mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees with clear skies near Fireman's Park. The moon is a waxing crescent, and we have an ISS flyover at 8:23 PM, moving from Cross Plains toward Madison. Expect an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain predicted.
There were no new emails received for the city today, allowing us to focus on our community happenings.
There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
On September 5th, police responded to a string of reports involving the Dairy Dare prank, where officers found slices of cheese left on car windshields throughout several streets.
Today's featured flavor is Pumpkin Pecan. The Verona location is currently open and will be serving guests until 11 PM tonight.
